projects.name: HappiQuick — Real-Time Venue Booking Platform
projects.technologies: React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Razorpay, Docker
projects.description:
A full-stack venue booking platform where guests search halls, place a 10-minute exclusive hold, pay via Razorpay, and receive a confirmed booking — with partners (venue owners) and admins getting their own dashboards.

Engineering highlights:
• Concurrency-safe holds using atomic MongoDB findOneAndUpdate with a unique AvailabilitySlot index, so two users can never book the same slot (race-condition proof).
• 10-minute exclusive holds with a live countdown; expired holds auto-release (lazy + 60s cron sweep).
• Session-conflict logic: a Full-day booking blocks Morning/Evening sessions and vice versa.
• Idempotent payments keyed by paymentIntentId (unique index) — duplicate callbacks create only one booking.
• Payment-after-expiry guard prevents bookings on expired holds and triggers a refund path.
• Cancellation flow returns the slot to AVAILABLE with policy enforcement.
• 6 automated edge-case tests (Jest + Supertest + mongodb-memory-server) covering concurrency, expiry, conflicts, and duplicate payments.

projects.name: Happiffie — AI-Powered Vendor Matching Engine
projects.technologies: React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Google Gemini API, Tailwind CSS
projects.description:
An intelligent event-management marketplace that matches hosts with verified vendors (caterers, photographers, decorators, venues, entertainers) using a hybrid AI + deterministic engine.

How it works:
• Gemini 1.5 Flash parses unstructured natural-language requests (e.g. "South Indian wedding in Chennai, 300 guests, ₹2.5L") into structured JSON.
• A deterministic backend enforces hard eligibility filters (category, date availability, travel radius, guest capacity) and ranks vendors with a transparent 7-factor weighted score (0–100%).
• Resilient fallback: degrades to regex parsing + template rationale if the AI API times out or is unconfigured — no crashes.

Key features:
• Dual-mode Requirement Studio (natural text OR structured form).
• "Inspect Audit Score" modal shows the exact math and weight distribution per vendor — fully explainable matching.
• Vendor invitation dispatch with real-time response tracking.
• Admin/engine control console to seed vendors and tune algorithm weights.

projects.name: RAG System — Document Q&A
projects.technologies: React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, Google Gemini API
projects.description:
A full-stack Retrieval-Augmented Generation app where users upload PDF/DOCX/TXT documents and ask natural-language questions answered only from the uploaded content, with cited source chunks.

Pipeline (7 stages):
• LOAD — extract text (pdf-parse v2, mammoth, fs).
• SPLIT — sliding-window overlapping chunking.
• EMBED — Gemini gemini-embedding-001 (3072-dim vectors).
• STORE — MongoDB Atlas with { text, embedding, sourceName }.
• RETRIEVE — embed the question → MongoDB $vectorSearch (ANN, cosine) with optional sourceName filter.
• AUGMENT — inject retrieved chunks + question into the prompt.
• GENERATE — Gemini synthesizes the answer and cites sources.

Highlights:
• Reused MongoDB Atlas as the vector DB (no separate infra) — vector index with 3072 dims + cosine similarity + sourceName filter field.
• Free-tier Gemini for both embeddings and generation (reproducible by anyone, no credit card).
• Source-scoped retrieval: query one document or the whole knowledge base.
